title: 第23章 胜利品结算第24章 孤男寡女一室
slug: 双修暴击十万次仙子倒贴求放过
content_zh:
赵清寒站在一旁，目光淡漠，但并未阻止他搜刮战利品毕竟，这一战，顾平功不可没。
顾平小心翼翼地取下黑袍金丹腰间的储物袋，神识探入，顿时倒吸一口凉气，足足有5000枚下品灵石，甚至还有3枚中品灵石！
不仅如此，还有一件血煞幡，这是金丹上品法宝，能释放腐蚀血雾，但需血煞之气催动。
价值不菲，顾平预估这东西价值不低于20中灵。
一个罗盘法宝，不知品级，可遮掩气息，就是这玩意，让赵清寒都未能第一时间察觉这群魔修躲在哪；
一枚血婴丹，是邪修用来突破元婴的丹药，但副作用极大。
还有三本功法：《炼血大阵详解》记载了血衣盟的魔修秘术，价值极高，就是因为这部秘术，血衣盟才猖狂至今；《血煞魔功》，邪修功法，但其中有些秘术可借鉴；一部《九阶遁术》，似乎是一门逃跑的功法。
还有几瓶丹药，金丹阶的疗伤丹3瓶，血煞丹去10瓶。
他把这些战利品摆在地上，然后去掏其他黑袍人的储物袋。
十几名黑袍人，大多是筑基初期或炼气巅峰，虽然单个不算富裕，但加起来也是一笔不小的财富。
灵石总计8000枚下品灵石，不算少数，看来栽在他们手上的修士不少，血针法器，筑基下品，适合偷袭；血煞刀，筑基中品，适合体修；护心镜，筑基下品，防御类。
15瓶筑基期的疗伤丹；72瓶魔修专用的血煞丹。
这些战利品仅仅只是灵石都堆了一堆，堪称丰厚。
顾平看了看赵清寒，见她没有插手的意思，便主动提议。
“这些功法除了邪修功法给圣女殿下带走，《九阶遁术》我们各留一份。
圣女殿下是我军主力，功劳最大，这3枚中灵，血煞幡，罗盘法宝，血婴丹还有这些金丹阶的丹药就归圣女殿下了。
总共枚下灵，楚师姐分6000枚，我分4000枚，苏师姐分3000枚，但是筑基中品的血煞刀我要了。
血针法器和护心镜，楚师姐和苏师姐你俩各自挑选。”
“筑基阶的疗伤丹，我们平分，每人正好5瓶。”
“血煞丹收集起来回宗之后卖给珍宝楼，换成灵石之后我们平分。”

他说完之后。
楚玉和苏媚都点头，她们很识趣的没有提及这些邪修修士尸体的分配，包括那一具金丹巅峰邪修的尸体，这也表明了她们认可了顾平功劳。
楚玉嗔怪顾平一眼。
她怎么能不知道顾平给她分那么多灵石的原因？
那么多灵石都给她，她回宗门之后，还不是要拿着灵石去找顾平双修？
到最后，这灵石就都到这老头子那里去了。
打的好算盘。
这糟老头子坏的很。
苏媚此刻完全是一种放空自己的状态，大仇得报之后，对于这些战利品的分配并不怎么上心，甚至有一种死寂的感觉。
“顾平。”
赵清寒忽然开口，声音清冷，“你今日功劳不小，这罗盘法宝，你就留着用吧，遮掩气息的宝贝我有。”
顾平一愣，随即伸手接过来，恭敬行礼：“多谢圣女大人！”
赵清寒颔首。
从宗门出发的时候，她只觉得这老修士为人义气。
在飞剑上的时候，她又觉得老头子心思敏感。
进城，遇到了事之后，哎！
她就发现这这个看似行将就木的老修士，不仅人机灵，修为还扎实异常，尤其是他身上的特殊灵力，还最后抵挡黑袍金丹的血符时，他身上出现了未知高阶修士留下来的后手……这个老头子藏着连她都看不透的秘密。
content_en:
Zhao Qinghan stood aside with an indifferent look, but he did not stop him from searching for loot. After all, Gu Ping played an important role in this battle.
Gu Ping carefully removed the storage bag from the waist of the black-robed golden elixir. When his spiritual consciousness penetrated it, he suddenly took a breath of cold air. There were a total of 5,000 low-grade spiritual stones, and even 3 medium-grade spiritual stones!
Not only that, there is also a blood evil flag, which is a high-grade golden elixir magic weapon that can release corrosive blood mist, but it needs the blood evil energy to activate it.
It is worth a lot of money. Gu Ping estimates that this thing is worth no less than 20 souls.
A compass magic weapon, whose grade is unknown, can cover the aura. Even this thing prevented Zhao Qinghan from immediately noticing where these demon cultivators were hiding;
A Blood Infant Pill is a pill used by evil cultivators to break through the Nascent Soul, but it has extremely side effects.
There are also three books on skills: "Detailed Explanation of the Blood Refining Formation" records the secret skills of the Blood Clothes Alliance, which is extremely valuable. It is because of this secret skill that the Blood Clothes Alliance is rampant to this day; "The Blood Demon Skills" contains evil skills, but some of the secret skills can be used for reference; and "Ninth Level Escape Technique" seems to be an escape skill.
There are also several bottles of elixirs, including 3 bottles of golden elixir-level healing elixirs and 10 bottles of blood evil elixirs.
He placed these trophies on the ground, and then went to dig out the storage bags of other men in black robes.
Most of the dozen or so men in black robes are in the early stages of foundation building or at the peak of Qi refining. Although they are not rich individually, they add up to a considerable amount of wealth.
There are a total of 8,000 low-grade spiritual stones, which is not a handful. It seems that many monks have fallen into their hands. The blood needle weapon is a low-grade foundation-building weapon, suitable for sneak attacks; the blood-shattering sword is a medium-grade foundation-building weapon, suitable for physical cultivation; and the heart-protecting mirror is a low-grade foundation-building weapon, suitable for defense.
15 bottles of healing pills for the foundation-building period; 72 bottles of blood-evil pills for demon cultivators.
These trophies were just a pile of spiritual stones, which was quite generous.
Gu Ping looked at Zhao Qinghan and saw that she had no intention of interfering, so he took the initiative to propose.
"Except for the evil cultivating skills, which were taken away by Her Majesty the Saint, we each kept a copy of the "Ninth Level Escape Technique".
Her Royal Highness the Saint is the main force of our army and has the greatest credit. The three inner spirits, the Blood Demon Banner, the compass magic weapon, the Blood Infant Pill and these golden elixir-level elixirs belong to Her Royal Highness.
There are a total of 6,000 Spirits for Senior Sister Chu, 4,000 for me, and 3,000 for Senior Sister Su, but I want the middle-grade Foundation Establishment Blood Sword.
The blood needle magic weapon and the heart-protecting mirror, Senior Sister Chu and Senior Sister Su, you two can choose each one. "
"We will share the healing pills of the Foundation Establishment level equally, each of us has exactly 5 bottles."
"Collect the Blood Evil Pills and return them to the sect, sell them to Zhenbao House, and exchange them for spiritual stones and we will share them equally."
After he finished speaking.
Chu Yu and Su Mei both nodded. They wisely did not mention the distribution of the corpses of these evil cultivators, including the corpse of the evil cultivator at the peak of the Golden Core. This also showed that they recognized Gu Ping's contribution.
Chu Yu glared at Gu Ping.
How could she not know the reason why Gu Ping gave her so many spiritual stones?
After giving her so many spirit stones, after she returned to the sect, didn't she still have to take the spirit stones to find Gu Ping Shuangxiu?
In the end, all the spiritual stones went to the old man.
Good calculation.
This bad old man is very bad.
Su Mei was completely in a state of letting go of herself at the moment. After her great revenge was avenged, she didn't care much about the distribution of the spoils, and even felt a sense of death.
"Gu Ping."
Zhao Qinghan suddenly spoke with a cold voice, "You have done a lot today. Just keep this compass magic weapon for use. I have a treasure that can cover your breath."
Gu Ping was stunned for a moment, then reached out to take it and saluted respectfully: "Thank you, Holy Lady!"
Zhao Qinghan nodded.
When she left the sect, she only felt that the old monk was loyal.
When she was on Feijian, she felt that the old man was sensitive again.
After entering the city and encountering something, hey!
She discovered that this old monk, who seemed to be on his deathbed, was not only clever, but also extremely solid in cultivation. Especially his special spiritual power.When he finally resisted the blood talisman of the black-robed golden elixir, the backhand left by an unknown high-level monk appeared on his body... This old man was hiding a secret that even she couldn't see through.
